text:
nina.partner: Hey team — Atlas wants a quick pre-POC checklist. Main asks: HIPAA/GDPR controls, observability for token-level spend, and whether we can run a small local eval suite against their test vectors before demo. Demo target Thu 9am ET.

alex.sales: We told them pilot = 6 weeks, can do dedicated pool if they commit. Need to know expected sustained tokens/sec and peak. I'll push pricing scenarios.

dave.eng: For observability we can surface per-route token counts + latency percentiles. If they need per-user breakdown we'll need to tag requests with team/user ids. That adds a little header work on their side.

monica.solutions: I can draft the runbook and include the Console screenshots. Suggest sections: provisioning, SSO, entitlements mapping, warmup, traffic shaping, fallback policy.

priya.security: Quick security note: Atlas flagged HIPAA; we need a signed BAA for PHI. Hosted can do encryption at rest and audit logs; Private supports BYOK/HSM. I'll start the questionnaire answers.

nina.partner: They also asked about model fallback behavior if the dedicated pool is saturated — want deterministic graceful degradation (e.g., lower latency tier model). Can Redwood route to a smaller quantized variant automatically?

dave.eng: Yes — we can set a routing policy for capacity overflow to route to a quantized-compatible model family. Need to confirm acceptable quality delta. We should run their eval set to tune thresholds.

alex.sales: Pricing aside: question from legal — does BYOK incur an additional monthly platform fee? Also need SLA uptime numbers for dedicated.

priya.security: BYOK usually requires Private or a managed enterprise addendum. I'll flag legal. SLA for Dedicated is 99.9% (per contract) with defined maintenance windows.

monica.solutions: For the pre-demo eval: please upload a small sample (<=100 records) to a secure S3 link or paste obfuscated examples. We'll run them through rti-eval and share BLEU/EM/perplexity metrics + redwood quality score.

nina.partner: Atlas will send obfuscated records. Also they want to see cost estimates at 3 traffic profiles: dev (10 tps), staging (60 tps), prod (200 tps peak).

dave.eng: I'll assemble a quick cost matrix. Also note: cold-starts matter — we'll recommend a warmup policy (keep-alive + prefix caching) for the dedicated pool. I'll include curl examples to exercise KV cache.

monica.solutions: Example warmup command I'll include:
```
for i in {1..100}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TK" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-v1","prompt":"warmup example"}' &
done
```
This pre-loads kernels and primes KV cache.

priya.security: Security Qs being filed: data residency, deletion policy, access controls, audit log retention, and incident contact. We'll provide document with retention options (30/90/365 days).

alex.sales: Pushed initial quote to SFDC opp/10234 with three tiers; tagged for discount approval. Link: https://redwood.sales/opp/10234.

nina.partner: One more: they want an observability Slack alert for token burn anomalies and a webhook for model quality regression. Can we add those in the runbook?

dave.eng: Yes — Console supports alerting endpoints and webhooks. I'll include sample alert expressions (e.g., token_rate > mean*3) and a small alert-runbook for investigators.

monica.solutions: I'll put together a 1-page demo script, the tenant provisioning checklist, and the Git repo with sample curl + node client snippets. Will share the doc link in 3 hours.

priya.security: Also flagging compliance blocker: Atlas asked about SOC2 docs and penetration test schedule. Security will provide links and current pentest window.

ms-teams-bot: calendar invite created: Atlas POC kickoff Thu 09:00 ET — meeting id 54321.

alex.sales: Next steps: 1) Atlas sends obfuscated sample data + SAML metadata + CIDR allowlist 2) Security to deliver questionnaire + SOC2 link 3) Solutions + Eng to provision staging tenant and warm it 4) Sales to finalize pricing.

nina.partner: Thanks everyone — I'll relay the checklist to Atlas and push them for the sample data today. Ping me if any blockers. :pray:
